#### `Color::from_oklch`

```rust
pub fn from_oklch(lightness: f64, chroma: f64, hue: f64, alpha: f64) -> Self
```

Converts an OKLCH color to straight-alpha sRGB. `lightness` and
`alpha` are in `0..=1`, `chroma` is unbounded, and `hue` is in
degrees. Channels outside the sRGB gamut are clipped, as browsers
display them.

#### `Color::mix`

```rust
pub fn mix(self, other: Color, t: f64) -> Color
```

CSS `color-mix(in oklab, self, other t)`: `t` of `other` mixed into
`self` in OKLab, with alpha mixed linearly. For the near-gray roles
of the palettes this matches a mix in OKLCH.


`self` drawn over the opaque `background`.

## `DesignTokens`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::DesignTokens`

```rust
pub struct DesignTokens {
    pub base: BaseColor,
    pub scheme: ColorScheme,
    pub palette: Palette,
    pub radius: f64,
    pub spacing: f64,
    pub border_width: f64,
    pub ring_width: f64,
    pub ring_alpha: f64,
    pub text_scale: f64,
    pub type_scale: TypeScale,
    pub shadows: ShadowTable,
    pub font_sans: FontFamily,
    pub font_mono: FontFamily,
    pub motion: MotionTokens,
    pub contrast: Contrast,
    pub recipes: RecipeSet,
}
```

Resolved design values. Geometry-affecting values are explicit so a theme
update can distinguish layout from paint work.

### Fields

- `base`
- `scheme`
- `palette`
- `radius`: Base corner radius; `RadiusScale` steps are multiples of it.
- `spacing`: Spacing unit; `space(n)` is `n` units.
- `border_width`
- `ring_width`: Width of the outset focus ring.
- `ring_alpha`: Alpha of the focus ring color.
- `text_scale`: Multiplies every step of the type scale.
- `type_scale`: Font size and line height of each `TextSize` step.
- `shadows`: The layers of each `ShadowScale` step.
- `font_sans`
- `font_mono`
- `motion`
- `contrast`
- `recipes`: The recipe set that paints controls. Controls map it to their
  registered recipes; `RecipeSet::DEFAULT` is the built-in look.

## `FocusFrame`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::FocusFrame`

```rust
pub struct FocusFrame<V> { /* private fields */ }
```

Draws the focus ring around the focused node in `content`, above the
content and outside the clip of containers inside it. Thus a control
at the edge of a clipped panel still shows focus. The ring shows only
while focus is visible, after keyboard input. `controls::FocusFrame`
gives its geometry and paint. A frame inside another frame draws the
ring for its own content.

#### Examples

```rust
let panel = FocusFrame::new(ScrollView::new(VStack::new((
    Button::new("Save", || {}),
    Button::new("Cancel", || {}),
))));
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `FocusFrame::new`

```rust
pub fn new(content: V) -> Self
```

A frame that draws the focus ring for `content`.
